title: aegilops cylindrica var. aristulata
intro: Aegilops cylindrica var. aristulata, commonly known as 'Cylindrica Spelt', is a type of wild grass belonging to the wheat family. It is used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The plant is said to have therapeutic actions, including wound healing, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Aegilops cylindrica var. aristulata include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and other compounds that may contribute to its medicinal properties.
